newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon gets $220 mln in Patriot pacts.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon gets $220 mln in Patriot pacts.

text.p: Raytheon Co said on Monday it has received five recent contracts totaling more than $220 million for the Patriot Air Defense system.
The bulk of the contracts are with the U.S. Army Missile Command to upgrade the Patriot missile system, except for a $22.9 million award for radar enhancement kits for the Netherlands, Raytheon said.

Raytheon said the U.S. Army Missile Command awarded Raytheon: $82.7 million for fiscal year 1997 engineering services; $60.5 million modification to improve the radar system; $35.5 million contract to upgrade the system's ability to identify the targets; and a $19.0 million contract for remote launching system improvements.
